# Harris

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P13](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P19](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Harris is a dashing young person with big, rolling brown eyes and an extensive, bewildering smile. She wears a huge, drooping pompadour and dresses with exceeding smartness, adorned with several bangle bracelets that glitter, rattle, and tinkle when she moves her hands.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007)_

## History

Harris is a shopkeeper who assists [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) when he enters the store attempting to purchase a dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Becoming flustered by the transaction, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) ends up buying twenty pounds of brown sugar from Harris instead of the intended clothing item.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P34](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047)_
